verdicts.description: one entry per finding you were given, and no entry for a finding you were not given

id.description: the id of the finding this verdict applies to, copied exactly

verdict.description: confirmed keeps the finding as-is, refined keeps it with the corrections below, rejected drops it as wrong, immaterial drops it as technically true but not worth acting on, pre_existing moves it out as a problem the change under review did not introduce

line.description: corrected anchor line, only for a refined verdict

end_line.description: corrected last line of the range, only for a refined verdict

severity.description: corrected severity, only for a refined verdict

confidence.description: corrected confidence, only for a refined verdict

title.description: corrected title, only for a refined verdict

body.description: corrected explanation, only for a refined verdict

fix.description: corrected fix, only for a refined verdict

reason.description: why you reached this verdict, in one line
